zh.d: 支持文生图、图生图、文生视频、图生视频。在模型列表里把模型标为图片或视频类型即可使用，选中后发送框会切换到对应的生成模式，并按该模型支持的参数给出可调项；生成结果直接在会话里预览、播放和下载。

zh.t: 新增：一次生成多张独立图片
zh.d: 要 4 张就得到 4 张各自独立的图，而不是一张图里挤 4 个小图。若接口单次只回一张，会自动拆成多次请求。

zh.t: 新增：专家也能生成图片和视频
zh.d: 此前只有发送框能用生成模型，专家在对话中调用会被告知「没有配置模型」。现在声明过的图片/视频模型对专家同样可见，可以在任务过程中直接产图产片。

zh.t: 新增：生成花费在发送前后都可见
zh.d: 发送前给出本次生成的预估费用，完成后显示实际花费。没有可用费率时会明说「费用未知」，而不是显示 0。
从浏览器访问时也能发起和取消生成、看到作业列表与实时进度、加载生成的图片和视频；「打开所在目录」在远程访问时会自动换成下载。

zh.t: 新增：企业可管控生成的成本与模型
zh.d: 图片与视频生成此前完全绕过企业的成本上限和模型白名单，现已纳入，用量也会计入统计。

zh.t: 修复：Claude 和 Codex 在全新安装上起不来
zh.d: 2.1.51 的安装包漏掉了 Claude 与 Codex 所需的运行组件，全新安装的机器上这两个后端无法启动（升级的机器因本地留有旧组件而不受影响）。组件已重新入包，打包与装机两道校验也都会在缺失时直接失败。

zh.t: 修复：运行时组件出错的弹窗关不掉
zh.d: 该弹窗此前没有任何可见的关闭方式，只能猜着按 Esc；文案还会建议重装应用，而重装并不能解决问题。现在有明确的关闭按钮，提示也改为可实际操作的说明。

zh.t: 修复：参考图过几天就失效
zh.d: 选来的参考图原先留在系统临时目录，被系统清理后「重新生成」必然失败。现在参考图会随会话一起保存。

zh.t: 修复：界面上的内部代号
zh.d: 会话页面曾直接显示内部标识符，对外请求也仍以上游项目的名义自报来源，均已更正。

en.d: Text-to-image, image-to-image, text-to-video and image-to-video are all supported. Mark a model as an image or video model in the model list and it becomes usable: selecting it switches the composer into the matching generation mode and offers the parameters that model actually supports. Results preview, play and download directly in the conversation.

en.t: New: generate several separate images at once
en.d: Ask for four images and you get four independent images, not one image split into four panels. When an endpoint returns only a single image per call, the request is split automatically.

en.t: New: experts can generate images and video too
en.d: Previously only the composer could use generation models; an expert calling the tool was told no model was configured. Declared image and video models are now visible to experts, so they can produce images and clips as part of a task.

en.t: New: cost shown before and after generating
en.d: You see an estimate before sending and the actual cost once it finishes. When no rate is available it says so plainly instead of showing 0.

en.t: New: generation works in the browser
en.d: From the web UI you can start and cancel jobs, see the job list and live progress, and load generated images and video. "Open containing folder" becomes a download when you are connected remotely.

en.t: New: enterprise controls apply to generation
en.d: Image and video generation used to bypass the enterprise spending cap and model allowlist entirely. Both now apply, and usage is counted.

en.t: Fixed: Claude and Codex would not start on a clean install
en.d: The 2.1.51 installer was missing the runtime components Claude and Codex need, so neither backend started on a freshly installed machine (upgrades were unaffected because the old components were still on disk). The components are back in the package, and both the build-time and install-time checks now fail outright when they are absent.

en.t: Fixed: the runtime-component error dialog could not be dismissed
en.d: The dialog offered no visible way to close it, and its text suggested reinstalling the app — which does not fix the problem. It now has a clear close button and actionable wording.

en.t: Fixed: reference images expiring after a few days
en.d: Reference images used to be read from the system temp directory, so once the OS cleaned it up, "regenerate" always failed. They are now saved alongside the conversation.

en.t: Fixed: internal code names visible in the UI
en.d: The conversation page showed an internal identifier, and outbound requests still identified themselves under the upstream project's name. Both are corrected.
